kesoutdoor_assistant.text: Boots, maps, waterproofs and the sort of socks that change your life. Keswick is basically one big outdoor shop with a lake.
Alfred Wainwright walked and drew every fell in his guides. There are 214 of them, and plenty of people are trying to bag the lot.

then.text: One bar each, or you will bounce all the way up Skiddaw. Off you go.

else.text: Kendal mint cake is proper walking fuel. Joseph Wiper made the first batch by accident in 1869, and later it went up Everest. Here, have a piece.
